# Load dataset

```{r,warning=FALSE}
df=readRDS("C:\\Users\\P095206\\OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC\\Shared material with Elia\\PhD\\Project 5 - Simulation study in SATs\\Data\\paper\\main_analysis\\with duration\\continuous\\population_diff_0.15.rds") 
#df=readxl::read_xlsx("C:\\Users\\P095206\\OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC\\Shared material with Elia\\PhD\\Project 5 - Simulation study in SATs\\Data\\population_hui_like_dur.xlsx")
# keep only treated participants with enough visits
df=df %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(flag_trt=ifelse(trt_overall==1 & sum(trt)<5,1,0),
         flag_untrt=ifelse(trt_overall==0 & max(row_number())<5,1,0)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(flag_untrt==0 & flag_trt==0)
```

# Single calls

## Create dftrial

```{r}
# set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(11112000)
# sample untreated
untrtid=unique(df$id[which(df$trt_overall==0 & df$dateonset<df$trialdate)])
# sample treated
trtid=unique(df$id[which(df$trt_overall==1 & df$dateonset<df$trialdate)])
# bind together
ids=c(sample(untrtid,250),sample(trtid,20))
```

Bind them together

```{r}
trialdf=df %>% 
  #filter(miss==0) %>% 
  filter(id %in% ids) 
```

Define duration

```{r}
trialdf=trialdf %>% 
  mutate(across(c(date,dateonset,starttrial,lastvisit,trialdate),as.Date)) %>% 
  mutate(time=time/365.25) 
```

```{r}
treateddf=trialdf %>% 
  filter(trt_overall==1)
```

# Alignment without confounding

```{r}
matched=duration_matching_interpolation(data=trialdf,identifier=id,
                                        y=hui_linear_trt,
                 treatment=trt_overall,
                 duration=duration,time=timen,
                 ratio=2)
# extract matched dataset
matcheddf=matched$interpolated %>% 
  arrange(id, timen) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(hui_baseline=first(y)) %>% 
  filter(row_number()!=1) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

Plot

```{r}
# select random cluster
clusters=sample(unique(matcheddf$cluster),5)
# plot cluster without baseline
matcheddf %>% 
  filter(cluster %in% clusters) %>% 
  filter(time_aligned<=2) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(x=time_aligned,
               y=y,col=factor(trt_overall),group = id))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  guides(col='none')+
  xlim(0,2)+
  facet_wrap(~cluster)+
  theme_bw()
# plot cluster with baseline
matched$interpolated %>% 
  filter(cluster %in% clusters) %>% 
  filter(time_aligned<=2) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(x=time_aligned,
               y=y,col=factor(trt_overall),group = id))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  guides(col='none')+
  xlim(0,2)+
  facet_wrap(~cluster)+
  theme_bw()
```

Get estimate

```{r}
# model
trial=matcheddf %>% 
  filter(time_aligned<=2) %>%
  lmer(y~(1|cluster)+(1|cluster:id)+hui_baseline+trt*time_aligned+yoo+enter,.)
# contrast
estimand=emmeans(trial, ~ trt | time_aligned,
                              at = list(time_aligned=2))
# see contrast
ate=summary(contrast(estimand, method="trt.vs.ctrl", ref=1))$estimate[1]
```

# Correct alignment

## exact matching

### single procedure

```{r}
matched=matching_interpolation(data=trialdf,identifier=id,y=hui_linear_trt,
                 treatment=trt_overall,ageofonset=aoo,
                 sex=sex,duration=duration,time=timen,
                 ratio=1,
                 #caliper=NULL,step=NULL,maxcaliper=NULL,
                 caliper=0.5,step=0.1,maxcaliper=0.5,
                 method='greedy')
# extract matched dataset
matcheddf=matched$interpolated %>% 
  arrange(id, timen) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(hui_baseline=first(y)) %>% 
  filter(row_number()!=1) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

Plot

```{r}
# select random cluster
clusters=sample(unique(matched$interpolated$cluster),5)
# plot cluster with baseline
matched$interpolated %>% 
  filter(cluster %in% clusters) %>% 
  filter(time_aligned>=0 & time_aligned<=2) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(x=time_aligned,
               y=y,col=factor(trt_overall),group = id))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  guides(col='none')+
  facet_wrap(~cluster)+
  theme_bw()
# plot cluster without baseline
matcheddf %>% 
  filter(cluster %in% clusters) %>% 
  filter(time_aligned>=0 & time_aligned<=2) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(x=time_aligned,
               y=y,col=factor(trt_overall),group = id))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  guides(col='none')+
  facet_wrap(~cluster)+
  theme_bw()
```

Run analysis

```{r}
options(scipen=999)
trial=matcheddf %>% 
  filter(time_aligned<=2) %>%
  lmer(y~(1|cluster)+(1|cluster:id)+hui_baseline+trt*time_aligned+yoo+enter,.)
```

Get estimate

```{r}
estimand=emmeans(trial, ~ trt | time_aligned,
                              at = list(time_aligned=2))
# see contrast
ate=summary(contrast(estimand, method="trt.vs.ctrl", ref=1))$estimate[1]
```

## random forest

### single procedure

```{r}
matched=psm_matching_interpolation(data=trialdf,
                                   identifier=id,outcome=hui_linear_trt,
                     formula=trt_overall~aoo+sex,duration=duration,time=timen,
                     ratio=2,replacement=F,tune=F,seed=181299,
                     distance='glm',method='optimal',caliper=NULL)
```

Run analysis

```{r}
options(scipen=999)
trial=matched$interpolated %>% 
  filter(time_aligned<=2) %>%
  lmer(y~(1|cluster)+(1|cluster:id)+trt*time_aligned+yoo,.)
```

Get estimate

```{r}
estimand=emmeans(trial, ~ trt | time_aligned,
                              at = list(time_aligned=2),
                 cov.reduce=list(yoo=mean))
# see contrast
ate=summary(contrast(estimand, method="trt.vs.ctrl", ref=1))$estimate[1]
```
